remarks: Experience elevated city living in one of Buffalo's most sought-after condominium buildings, ideally situated along Delaware Avenue's historic Millionaires' Row. This beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers the perfect blend of timeless elegance, modern updates, and an unbeatable location.  The renovated kitchen features granite countertops, a stylish tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances, creating a sophisticated space for everyday living and entertaining. The fully updated bathroom showcases contemporary finishes and a walk-in glass-enclosed shower. The spacious bedroom offers double closets, providing ample storage and comfort.  Filled with natural light, the inviting living room overlooks the beautifully illuminated gardens of the Himalayan Arts Institute, offering peaceful views and a serene urban retreat.  Residents enjoy the convenience of onsite parking, elevator access, and a rooftop patio, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or taking in the city skyline.  Perfectly situated near Elmwood Village, Allentown, the Buffalo AKG Art Museum and the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, this exceptional condo offers convenient access to Buffalo’s premier dining, shopping, cultural attractions, parks, and recreational amenities.  Whether you're walking, biking, or exploring the city, this prime location offers unparalleled access to everything Buffalo has to offer!  HOA fees include heat & electric.
